extraction_notes.note: Bilingual \en{}/\ja{} bodies: each environment states its content twice; the duplicated numbered equations in the \ja copy are kept in also_stated_at of the \en equation node. The English and Japanese versions of PrP1 differ (en: e,f greater than two, non-positive i; ja: coprime e,f >= 2, positive l, natural i).
Apparent typos copied verbatim: LP23-LP25 state '=' where the labels say 'ne'; LP28 writes n|e for e|n; PP1 uses e for d; PP10 proves the statement for II_{el,fl} while LP37 is about II_{e,f}.
The closing Introduction paragraph on computer verification and the project's goal (formalize pr:main) is discursive and gets no node.
Unlabelled prose fragments after the Section 3 lemmas and at the start of Case I were split into claims/assumptions by judgment.
Stated without proof or citation ('この時、次が成り立つ'); likely from the authors' arXiv:2406.15915, but kept origin paper since no citation is given.

The finishing step does not treat the Japanese full stop as a sentence end, so it counts PP3/PP8/PP10 (3-6 sentences) as at most two sentences and rejects their steps; steps were dropped to pass, and Japanese prose nodes get mid-sentence warnings.
Blueprint is incomplete: no node proves the main proposition, and PP9 only states a proof plan; edges from the Chapter 4 lemmas to PrP1 are low-confidence inferences.

metadata.extraction_comment: Lean blueprint (mostly Japanese) of the proof of Lekili-Ueda Proposition 5.1; most lemmas have no prose proof because they are formalized in Lean.

nodes.name: Simple singularities A_l, D_l, E_6, E_7, E_8
nodes.statement: \begin{split} A_\ell &\colon x_1^{\ell+1} + x_2^2 + \cdots + x_{n+1}^2 = 0, \quad \ell = 1, 2, \ldots \\ D_\ell &\colon x_1^{\ell-1} + x_1 x_2^2 + x_3^2+ \cdots + x_{n+1}^2 = 0, \quad \ell = 4, 5, \ldots \\ E_6 &\colon x_1^4 + x_2^3 + x_3^2 + \cdots + x_{n+1}^2 = 0, \\ E_7 &\colon x_1^3 + x_1 x_2^3 + x_3^2 + \cdots + x_{n+1}^2 = 0, \\ E_8 &\colon x_1^5 + x_2^3 + x_3^2 + \cdots + x_{n+1}^2 = 0. \end{split}

nodes.name: Evans-Lekili conjecture
nodes.statement: \en{A compound Du Val singularity admits a small resolution if and only if the dimension of the symplectic cohomology of its Milnor fiber is constant in every negative cohomological degree. Furthermore, if this is the case, then this dimension is equal to the number of irreducible components of the exceptional locus of a small resolution.} \ja{ cDV特異点は、 そのミルナーファイバーのシンプレクティックコホモロジーの次元が 負の全ての次数で一定である場合に限り、 小さな特異点解消を持つ。 さらに、この場合、 この次元は小さな特異点解消の例外集合の既約成分の数に等しい。 }
assumptions: if this is the case,
conclusions: A compound Du Val singularity admits a small resolution if and only if the dimension of the symplectic cohomology of its Milnor fiber is constant in every negative cohomological degree.
then this dimension is equal to the number of irreducible components of the exceptional locus of a small resolution.
equivalent_conditions: A compound Du Val singularity admits a small resolution
the dimension of the symplectic cohomology of its Milnor fiber is constant in every negative cohomological degree

conclusions: A compound Du Val singularity admits a small resolution if and only if the dimension of the symplectic cohomology of its Milnor fiber is constant in every negative cohomological degree.

assumptions: if this is the case,
conclusions: then this dimension is equal to the number of irreducible components of the exceptional locus of a small resolution.

nodes.statement_short: A cDV singularity has a small resolution iff dim SH of its Milnor fiber is constant in negative degrees; then it equals the number of exceptional components.
nodes.label: cj:Evans-Lekili

nodes.name: Refined Evans-Lekili conjecture
nodes.statement: \en{ Let $Y \to X$ be a small $\bQ$-factorialization of a compound Du Val singularity $P \in X$. Let further $\ell$ be the number of irreducible components of the exceptional locus, $\Uv$ be the Milnor fiber of $P \in X$, and $\Uv_1,\ldots,\Uv_r$ be the Milnor fibers of the resulting $\bQ$-factorial singularities $Q_1,\ldots, Q_r \in Y$. Then one has \begin{align} \dim \SH^i \left( \Uv \right) = \sum_{j=1}^r \dim \SH^i \left( \Uv_j \right) + \ell \end{align} for any $i < 0$.} \ja{ $Y \to X$をcDV特異点$P \in X$の小さな$\bQ$分解化とする。 さらに、$\ell$を例外集合の既約成分の数、 $\Uv$を$P \in X$のミルナーファイバー、 $\Uv_1,\ldots,\Uv_r$を $\bQ$分解化の結果として得られた$\bQ$分解的特異点 $Q_1,\ldots, Q_r \in Y$のミルナーファイバーとする。 この時、任意の$i < 0$に対して、 \begin{align} \dim \SH^i \left( \Uv \right) = \sum_{j=1}^r \dim \SH^i \left( \Uv_j \right) + \ell \end{align} が成り立つ。 }
nodes.origin_citation: Evans & Lekili (proposed by the authors of [EL23], unpublished calculations)
assumptions: Let $Y \to X$ be a small $\bQ$-factorialization of a compound Du Val singularity $P \in X$.

Let further $\ell$ be the number of irreducible components of the exceptional locus, $\Uv$ be the Milnor fiber of $P \in X$, and $\Uv_1,\ldots,\Uv_r$ be the Milnor fibers of the resulting $\bQ$-factorial singularities $Q_1,\ldots, Q_r \in Y$.
nodes.statement_short: For a small Q-factorialization of a cDV singularity, dim SH^i of the Milnor fiber equals the sum over the resulting singularities plus the number of exceptional components, for i<0.
nodes.label: cj:refined_Evans-Lekili

nodes.name: Refined Evans-Lekili formula
nodes.statement: \dim \SH^i \left( \Uv \right) = \sum_{j=1}^r \dim \SH^i \left( \Uv_j \right) + \ell
nodes.origin_citation: Evans & Lekili (proposed by the authors of [EL23])

nodes.name: Refined Evans-Lekili conjecture for x^2+y^2+z^e+w^f
nodes.statement: \cite{2406.15915}では、 2以上の整数$e$と$f$に対して \begin{align} x^2 + y^2 + z^{e} + w^{f} = 0 \end{align} で定義されるcDV特異点に対して \Cref{cj:refined_Evans-Lekili}が成り立つ事を示した。
assumptions: 2以上の整数$e$と$f$に対して
nodes.statement_short: The refined Evans-Lekili conjecture holds for the cDV singularities $x^2+y^2+z^e+w^f=0$, $e,f\ge 2$.

nodes.name: Milnor fiber U_{e,f}
nodes.statement: このcDV特異点のMilnorファイバーを $\Uv_{e,f}$と置くと、 そのシンプレクティックコホモロジーは ホモロジー的ミラー対称性によって ある（群作用付きの）超曲面の 安定導来圏のHochschildコホモロジーと同型であり、 後者は組合せ論的な記述を持つ。
nodes.statement_short: $\Uv_{e,f}$ is the Milnor fiber of the singularity; its SH is Hochschild cohomology of a stable derived category, with a combinatorial description.

nodes.name: Set I_{e,f}^i
nodes.statement: $ \rI_{e,f}^i \coloneqq \{ n \in \bN \mid n \not \equiv - 1 \mod e \ \text{かつ} \ n \not \equiv - 1 \mod f \ \text{かつ} \ \lfloor n / e \rfloor + \lfloor n / f \rfloor = i \} $
nodes.statement_short: Naturals n not ≡ -1 mod e or mod f with ⌊n/e⌋+⌊n/f⌋ = i.
nodes.label: df:setI

nodes.name: Set II_{e,f}^i
nodes.statement: $ \rII_{e,f}^i \coloneqq \{ n \in \bN \mid n \equiv - 1 \mod e \ \text{かつ} \ n \equiv - 1 \mod f \ \text{かつ} \ \lfloor n / e \rfloor + \lfloor n / f \rfloor + 1 = i \} $
nodes.statement_short: Naturals n ≡ -1 mod e and mod f with ⌊n/e⌋+⌊n/f⌋+1 = i.
nodes.label: df:setII

nodes.name: Set III_{e,f}^i
nodes.statement: $ \rIII_{e,f}^i \coloneqq \{ \xi \in \bC \mid \xi \ne 1 \ \text{かつ} \ \xi^e = \xi^f = 1 \} $
nodes.statement_short: Common e-th and f-th roots of unity other than 1.
nodes.label: df:setIII

nodes.name: h_{e,f}^i
nodes.statement: $ h_{e,f}^i \coloneqq \left| \rI_{e,f}^i \right| + \left| \rII_{e,f}^i \times \rIII_{e,f}^i \right| $.
nodes.statement_short: $h_{e,f}^i = |I| + |II \times III|$.
nodes.label: df:h

nodes.name: Combinatorial formula for dim SH
nodes.statement: 任意の2以上の整数$e,f$と自然数$i$に対して \begin{align} h_{e,f}^i = \dim \SH^{-2i} \left( \Uv_{e,f} \right) = \dim \SH^{-2i+1} \left( \Uv_{e,f} \right) \end{align} が成り立つ。
assumptions: 任意の2以上の整数$e,f$と自然数$i$に対して
nodes.statement_short: $h_{e,f}^i$ equals the dimension of $\SH^{-2i}$ and $\SH^{-2i+1}$ of the Milnor fiber $\Uv_{e,f}$.
nodes.label: th:a combinatorial formula for dim SH

nodes.name: dim SH formula
nodes.statement: h_{e,f}^i = \dim \SH^{-2i} \left( \Uv_{e,f} \right) = \dim \SH^{-2i+1} \left( \Uv_{e,f} \right)

nodes.name: Reduction of the refined conjecture to the main proposition
nodes.statement: \Cref{th:a combinatorial formula for dim SH}を踏まえると、 \Cref{cj:refined_Evans-Lekili}は 次の\Cref{pr:main}に帰着される：
nodes.statement_short: Given the combinatorial formula, the refined Evans-Lekili conjecture reduces to the main proposition.

nodes.name: Main proposition (h_{el,fl} = l h_{e,f} + l - 1)
nodes.statement: \en{ For integers $e$ and $f$ greater than two and a non-positive integer $i$, one has \begin{align} h_{e \ell, f \ell}^i = \ell h_{e,f}^i + \ell - 1. \end{align} } \ja{任意の2以上の互いに素な整数$e$と$f$、正の整数$\ell$ および自然数$i$に対して、 \begin{align} h_{e \ell, f \ell}^i = \ell h_{e,f}^i + \ell - 1 \end{align} が成り立つ。}
assumptions: For integers $e$ and $f$ greater than two and a non-positive integer $i$,
nodes.statement_short: Scaling $e,f$ by $\ell$ gives $h_{e\ell,f\ell}^i = \ell h_{e,f}^i + \ell - 1$.
nodes.label: pr:main

nodes.name: Scaling identity for h
nodes.statement: h_{e \ell, f \ell}^i = \ell h_{e,f}^i + \ell - 1.

nodes.name: Adaloglou-Pasquotto-Zanardini Theorem C (v1)
nodes.statement: 任意の自然数$i$に対して、 $e (1+i)$を$e+f$で割った余りを $0 \le q < e+f$と置くと、 \begin{align} h_{e,f}^{i} = \begin{cases} \gcd(e,f)-1 & q = 0 \ \text{または}\ q=e+f-1, \\ q - 1 & 1 \le q \le \min \{e, f\}, \\ \min \{e, f\} - 1 & \min \{e, f\} < q < e+f-1, \end{cases} \end{align} が成り立つ。
nodes.origin_citation: Adaloglou, Pasquotto & Zanardini, arXiv:2404.17301v1, Theorem C
assumptions: 任意の自然数$i$に対して、 $e (1+i)$を$e+f$で割った余りを $0 \le q < e+f$と置くと、
conclusions: h_{e,f}^{i} = \begin{cases} \gcd(e,f)-1 & q = 0 \ \text{または}\ q=e+f-1, \\ q - 1 & 1 \le q \le \min \{e, f\}, \\ \min \{e, f\} - 1 & \min \{e, f\} < q < e+f-1, \end{cases}
nodes.statement_short: Closed formula for $h_{e,f}^i$ by cases on the remainder $q$ of $e(1+i)$ mod $e+f$ (later found incorrect).
nodes.label: th:APZ Theorem C v1

nodes.name: APZ formula v1
nodes.statement: h_{e,f}^{i} = \begin{cases} \gcd(e,f)-1 & q = 0 \ \text{または}\ q=e+f-1, \\ q - 1 & 1 \le q \le \min \{e, f\}, \\ \min \{e, f\} - 1 & \min \{e, f\} < q < e+f-1, \end{cases}

nodes.name: Computer check refutes APZ Theorem C (v1)
nodes.statement: この公式が正しければ、 \Cref{pr:main}が 系として従う。 しかし、 \href{https://github.com/uedakazushi/cluster_sfuk_lean/blob/master/dim_SH.ipynb}{SageMathを用いた計算} は、 この公式が正しくないことを示唆している。 このため、我々は\cite{2406.15915}で この公式に依存しない証明を与えた。
nodes.statement_short: APZ v1 would imply the main proposition, but SageMath computations suggest it is wrong, so an independent proof was given.

nodes.name: Adaloglou-Pasquotto-Zanardini Theorem C (v2)
nodes.statement: 任意の自然数$i$に対して、 $\min \{ e, f \} (1+i)$を$e+f$で割った余りを $0 \le q < e+f$と置くと、 \begin{align} h_{e,f}^{i} = \begin{cases} \gcd(e,f)-1 & q = 0, \\ q - 1 & 1 \le q \le \min \{e, f\}, \\ \min \{e, f\} - 1 & \min \{e, f\} < q \le \max \{e, f\}, \\ e + f - q - 1 & \max \{e, f\} < q \le e + f - 1, \end{cases} \end{align} が成り立つ。
nodes.origin_citation: Adaloglou, Pasquotto & Zanardini, arXiv:2404.17301v2, Theorem C
assumptions: 任意の自然数$i$に対して、 $\min \{ e, f \} (1+i)$を$e+f$で割った余りを $0 \le q < e+f$と置くと、
conclusions: h_{e,f}^{i} = \begin{cases} \gcd(e,f)-1 & q = 0, \\ q - 1 & 1 \le q \le \min \{e, f\}, \\ \min \{e, f\} - 1 & \min \{e, f\} < q \le \max \{e, f\}, \\ e + f - q - 1 & \max \{e, f\} < q \le e + f - 1, \end{cases}
nodes.statement_short: Corrected closed formula for $h_{e,f}^i$ by cases on the remainder of $\min\{e,f\}(1+i)$ mod $e+f$.
nodes.label: th:APZ Theorem C v2

nodes.name: APZ formula v2
nodes.statement: h_{e,f}^{i} = \begin{cases} \gcd(e,f)-1 & q = 0, \\ q - 1 & 1 \le q \le \min \{e, f\}, \\ \min \{e, f\} - 1 & \min \{e, f\} < q \le \max \{e, f\}, \\ e + f - q - 1 & \max \{e, f\} < q \le e + f - 1, \end{cases}

nodes.name: Proof of setII_dichotomy
nodes.statement: $ n \in \rII_{e \ell,f \ell}^i $ の時、 $ n \equiv -1 \mod e \ell $ かつ $ n \equiv -1 \mod f \ell $ なので、 $ n = e f \ell k - 1 $ と置くと、 \begin{align} \varphi_{e \ell, f \ell}(n) + 1 &= \lfloor n / e \ell \rfloor + \lfloor n / f \ell \rfloor + 1 \\ &= (f k - 1) + (e k - 1) + 1 \\ &= (e + f) k - 1 \end{align} より、 \begin{align} i \equiv -1 \mod e + f \end{align} が成り立つ。 $ i \equiv -1 \mod e + f $ の時、 $ k = (i+1) / (e + f) $, $ n = e f \ell k - 1 $ と置くと、 $ n \equiv -1 \mod e $ かつ $ n \equiv -1 \mod f $ で、しかも \begin{align} \varphi_{e \ell, f \ell}(n) + 1 &= \lfloor n / e \ell \rfloor + \lfloor n / f \ell \rfloor + 1\\ &= (f k - 1) + (e k - 1) + 1\\ &= (e + f) k - 2 + 1\\ &= i \end{align} が成り立つので、 $ i \in \rII_{e \ell, f\ell}^i $ である。 $ n' \ne n $ の時、 $ n' < n $ または $ n < n' $ が成り立つ。 $ n' < n $ が $ n' \in \rII_{e \ell,f \ell}^i $ を満たすなら、 $ n' \le n - e $ でなくてはならないが、 この時 $ \lfloor n'/e \rfloor < \lfloor n/e \rfloor $ かつ $ \lfloor n'/f \rfloor \le \lfloor n/f \rfloor $ なので、 \begin{align} \varphi_{e \ell, f \ell}(n') < \varphi_{e \ell, f \ell}(n) \end{align} を満たし、$n' \in \rII_{e \ell,f \ell}^i$に矛盾する。 同様に、 $n < n'$でも$n' \not \in \rII_{e \ell,f \ell}^i$である。
nodes.statement_short: Writing $n = ef\ell k - 1$ shows membership forces $i\equiv -1$, constructs the element, and rules out a second one by monotonicity.
